title: leefy's great comeback
content:
hey there! i've returned yet again yay!!! yeah my bad it's been quite hectic over here with school wrapping up, but i live! so what am i up to lately? well, not a whole ton? i have been playing a shit ton of overwatch (cough cough 56 HOURS in two weeks) mainly as a distraction from everything else, though it seems to stress me out even more than life at times :kek: i've mainly just been chillin out though :p

but! i did do something today... i signed up for hack club's stardance challenge! it's basically a thing forteens that allows you to earn prizes for working on projects! so that includes my site! along with my site,i've also used this as an opportunity to make my site with node.js! so that means at some point i'll have a backend for this site yay!!! i've been doing quite well with node, as i mentioned previously.if you're curious about the stardance challenge, you can sign up with this link! -->
